_comment: Every server we run; the launcher shows these. Pictures can be paths in this repo (servers/art/...) or links. icon: square, 128x128+. logo: transparent PNG wordmark, about 900x350. background: 1920x1080 screenshot (or .mp4/.webm clip). news: newest first, each {title, date, image, tag, url}. status: public | beta | private (needs code) | soon. address: what Play joins (host:port).

servers.name: Attack on Titan RPG
servers.description: Paradis and Marley, wall to coast. Swing through cities and giant forests, hunt titans with your squad, run the story, prestige past level 100, and when you're invited, take on extraction.

news.title: Swing sites: ruins, spires, groves and wall breaches in every region
Cutscenes fly between shots and conversations got a new look

servers.name: Stancebound
servers.tagline: Martial arts duels in a ruined kingdom.
servers.description: A melee combat server built around fighting styles: learn stances, chain attacks into your own combo deck, and prove it in duels and wandering fights.
